name: Harley-Davidson Pan America
engine: 1252 cc liquid-cooled Revolution Max V-twin, fuel injected, chain drive
intro: Harley's adventure bike. Early 2021 bikes had seat base and instrument cluster recalls.

A-002.title: Check for open recalls
A-002.instructions: Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls. Some 2021 bikes are in recall 21V924 (seat base) and 22V030 (instrument cluster).

recalls.what: Seat base may not be fastened properly, and the handhold part can fracture.
Instrument cluster may not show the speedometer and neutral light when cold.
recalls.fix: Dealer updates the cluster software free.
